notes: The welcome screen's photographs (owner, 2026-11-12): five Unsplash+ photographs that fill the screen behind the welcome's words and fade from one to the next, chosen by the owner against Strava's, Nike's and Tonal's welcomes on Mobbin. Unsplash+ rather than the free licence because its photographs carry model releases, which matter for faces on the screen that introduces the app. Each is the full source height cut to 9:19.5 around the subject, encoded as 1080 x 2340 WebP at quality 68, original colour, no retouching. The originals and nine backups were handed to the owner on 2026-11-12, since nothing can be downloaded once the subscription ends.
